newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur shares surge for second day.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur shares surge for second day.

text.p: Insurer Winterthur's registered shares surged for the second day on Wednesday, adding around 100 Swiss francs or seven percent from a close of 1,404 Swiss francs in afternoon trade.
Analysts said they were puzzled by the sharp rise, saying there were no fundamental changes to justify the day's advance or a Tuesday gain of over five percent.

Company financial officer Erwin Heiri told the business paper Finanz und Wirtschaft the surge was "the last twitches" of an excited stock market before correction. The blue-chip SMI was up 1.18 percent in afternoon trade.
